newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end up as blue chips gain.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end up as blue chips gain.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed slightly higher as blue chip shares gained amid selective trading by small investors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange price index rose 2.68 points or 0.2 percent to 1,191.1 on turnover of 105.3 million taka. Of the 133 issues traded 63 closed up, 62 ended down and eight unchanged.
Leasing company IDLC rose 59.30 taka to 3,108.71, Aziz Pipes gained 9.36 to 1,113.68, Bangladesh Lamps rose 45.64 to 3,289.76 and National Tubes was down 177.34 to 2,016.51.
Brokers said the market did not fall on profit-taking as anticipated due to the rise of blue chips and institutional support.
